title: fix(objectql): the bare-name refusal states the namespace rule for a narrowed type
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbTGhxJSYAmQXU7efVdNqrpw)_
Fixes #33507
Part of #33670

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：包重名被拒（安装时的 `Bare-name conflict` 与启动告警）给出的原因句，对已按命名空间收窄的类型改为说明新规则；另改 hook-binder 一段过时注释。
- 为什么改：原因句仍说「每个部署只能有一个同名项、按注册顺序选一个」，而 main 上 13 个受管类型都已收窄到命名空间，管理员读到的是一条不再成立的规则，不知道该改哪个名字。
- 风险与回滚：只改文案和注释，拒绝的判定、错误码 `NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` 与 422 状态都不变；回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/bare-name-one-holder.ts` 的 `bareNameReason`；其次 `registry-bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.test.ts` 里模拟未收窄类型的新用例。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/registry-bare-name-one-holder-flow-family.test.ts`，预期全绿，其中 flow 的原因句整句命中新文案。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **#33507** `bareNameReason` (`packages/objectql/src/bare-name-one-holder.ts`) branches on `isNamespaceScopedBareNameType`. A narrowed type is told its rule: "A flow holds one name per namespace: a package of another namespace may ship the same name, but within one namespace, or beside a package that declares no namespace, a name has one holder, and a bare name two holders share is refused naming both." A type not yet narrowed keeps today's one-name-per-deployment sentence with its consumers' clause; a list carrying both gets one sentence per rule, narrowed first. The doors' refusal and the cold-boot warning (`registry.ts`, untouched) both read this one function.
- Measured on origin/main 1e65a389e: `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES` holds all 13 covered types (`BARE_NAME_ONE_HOLDER_TYPES`), connector included since PR #33431. So no real type reaches the per-deployment sentence today; the branch is kept per the card's ruling and core's documented path (a type joining the covered list keeps one holder per deployment until its own narrowing lists it).
- **#33670 item 1** `packages/objectql/src/hook-binder.ts`: the function-bind comment no longer says the refusal "stays until the trailing backstop child (ADR-0150 D9) narrows it". It says what happens now: the rule is narrowed to the namespace, `claimBareNameFunctions` throws after the seal, the throw is not caught in the binder, and the runtime's `bindAppArtifactHandlers` catches it per owner group and logs at `error`, leaving that group's functions and hooks unbound. Comment only; no bind behaviour changes. Item 2 (`registry.ts` `bareNameColdBootWarning`) stays open on #33670.
- Changeset `.changeset/33507-bare-name-reason-namespace.md`, `@objectstack/objectql` patch.

## Tests

- Three unit pins that quoted the old sentence moved to the new one (`registry-bare-name-one-holder-{ai,flow,request}-family.test.ts`, describe retitled "states the rule of the types it lists").
- Narrowed type: `bareNameReason(['flow'])` pinned as the whole sentence, plus `bareNameReason()` (every covered type) never says "one name per deployment" or "chosen by registration order".
- Unnarrowed type: no covered type is unnarrowed on main, so the pin reads `tool` as not narrowed through `vi.doMock('@objectstack/core')` on a fresh module copy and pins the per-deployment sentence, and the two-sentence order for a mixed list.
- No dogfood pin quotes the reason (they match only the `Bare-name conflict` prefix), so none moved.

## Acceptance notes

- The card's "pin the sentence for one unnarrowed type" has no real subject on main (every covered type is narrowed); the pin is simulated, see above.
- `CONSUMER_CLAUSE` is now read only by the per-deployment branch, so on main it is unreachable from a real type. Kept with the branch.
- A bundle addition (a dependent package's email template member its base does not ship) is still refused across namespaces; the new sentence's "another namespace may ship the same name" does not name that exception.

## Verification

Readings on objectstack-ai/objectstack. Tests and typecheck re-run on the merged head `f1706ea92` (origin/main 45dee177b merged in); the gate sweep ran on `fe90b7362` (same diff before the merge, derivation identical on both), with the ratchet and changeset gates re-run on `f1706ea92`.

<details><summary>objectql suite and typecheck</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test` (fe90b7362): Test Files 596 passed (596), Tests 13138 passed (13138), exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck`: exit 0 on fe90b7362 and on f1706ea92.
- f1706ea92, the four bare-name files plus `hook-binder.test.ts`: Test Files 5 passed (5), Tests 366 passed (366).
- Direct dependents: no package outside objectql quotes the reason (`git grep` over packages for the old and new phrases). Spot check `@objectstack/cloud-connection` `marketplace-install-local-bare-name-conflict.test.ts`: 11 passed. The other dependents' suites are left to CI's Test Core.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (the narrowed-type pin)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `bare-name-one-holder.ts`, the two filter lines replaced by `narrowed = []` and `perDeployment = listed` (every type gets the old sentence back): "ok mutation landed: anchor 1 -> 0". Three family files: Tests 5 failed, 245 passed. One failure reads `expected 'A flow holds one name per deployment:…' to be 'A flow holds one name per namespace: …'`. Restore: "blob == HEAD (f94389afc112) and `git diff HEAD` is empty". A first ablation emptied both filters, so the function returned an empty string, not the old sentence. It also went red (5 failed), but it did not test the intended mutation, so it is not counted.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

- `dispatch-gates --ran`: 67 derived, 66 run, each with exit code 0, 0 NOT-MEASURED. 1 UNRUN: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, left to CI.
- `pnpm lint`: exit 0. `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs`: exit 0.
- Re-run on f1706ea92, each exit 0: durability-log-level, issue-citations, doc-authoring, test-source-alias, cross-package-test-inputs, type-check-coverage, changeset-no-major, adr-0087-registration, empty-changeset, nul-bytes, registry-log-declared.
- Dogfood: no `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm, so the full battery is not run. No dogfood pin quotes the reason.

</details>
